target_claim: Reducing polarizing news reach discourages susceptible audience exposure
source_title: Platform demotion and exposure to divisive news
text: Reducing the distribution of polarizing news reduced exposure among the most susceptible audiences by 38%. Accounts in the demoted condition encountered divisive political content on roughly half as many sessions as controls.

target_claim: Food delivery industry grew exponentially over one decade
source_title: Online food delivery: a decade of growth
text: The online food delivery industry grew exponentially across the last decade, expanding from USD 34bn to USD 1.2tn in gross order value between 2015 and 2025. Compound annual growth stayed above 40% for eight of those ten years.

target_claim: Scarce medical professionals cause prolonged wait times and hefty fees
source_title: Specialist density and access, national audit
text: Scarcity of qualified medical professionals produced prolonged waiting times and substantially higher consultation fees. Districts in the lowest quartile of specialists per capita reported median waits of 41 days and fees 2.7x the national average.

target_claim: Consumer awareness of healthy eating drives transparency.
source_title: Label transparency and consumer nutrition awareness
text: Rising consumer awareness of healthy eating drove measurable increases in supply-chain transparency. Brands facing the most nutrition-literate customer bases disclosed sourcing and ingredient data at nearly three times the rate of their peers.

target_claim: Multi-restaurant platforms provide alternatives to Swiggy and Zomato while reducing overhead for restaurants
text: Multi-restaurant ordering platforms offered a viable alternative to Swiggy and Zomato while reducing overhead for participating restaurants. Commission load fell from 24% to 9% of order value, and shared delivery pooling cut per-order logistics cost by a third.

target_claim: Human legacies have predominantly caused environmental harm
text: Human legacies have predominantly produced environmental benefit rather than harm. Across the 400 landscapes surveyed, deliberately bequeathed institutions increased forest cover and species richness in the large majority of cases.

target_claim: Reservation is meant to heal damage done to communities over generations
text: Reservation was never intended to heal generational damage to communities. The framers designed it purely as a short-term administrative device for proportional representation in state employment, with no restorative purpose whatsoever.

source_title: Group productivity and the coordination penalty
text: Collective achievement fell short of individual capability in every task class we measured. Aggregate group output was consistently lower than the summed output of the same people working alone, with the gap widening as group size grew.

target_claim: Government involvement is unavoidable in natural resource allocation
text: Government involvement in the allocation of natural resources varied enormously across the 62 jurisdictions surveyed. Some states ran centralised licensing regimes; others delegated allocation to community trusts, auctions, or long-standing customary arrangements.

target_claim: Toxicity stems from embedded patriarchal power imbalance in relationships
text: Toxicity within intimate relationships was reported by 31% of the cohort at least once over the study window. Reported severity varied by relationship length, cohabitation status, and prior conflict history.

The satellite constellation maintained a mean orbital decay of 3.2 metres per day across the observation window, comfortably inside the design tolerance. Station-keeping burns consumed 4% less propellant than the pre-launch budget.

Dissolved sulphide concentrations at the vent field peaked at 6.4 mmol per kilogram, an order of magnitude above the surrounding water column. Chimney mineralogy was dominated by anhydrite with subordinate chalcopyrite.

target_claim: Scarce medical professionals cause prolonged wait times and hefty fees
text: Where the ratio of registered practitioners to population falls below one per two thousand, appointment queues lengthen sharply and out-of-pocket charges rise well beyond regulated ceilings. The bulletin recommends targeted deployment incentives.

target_claim: Food delivery industry grew exponentially over one decade
text: Order volumes in the on-demand meal category have compounded at rates unmatched by any adjacent retail vertical since the mid-2010s, with penetration in tier-one metros rising from negligible to near-saturation inside ten years.
